{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to only loyal customers
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute the number of loyal customers and conversions
n_loyal = len(loyal_df)
n_converted = loyal_df['converted'].sum()
conversion_fraction = loyal_df['converted'].mean()

# Print all results
n_loyal, n_converted, conversion_fraction"}
